title: Dependency map viewport
responsibility: Calculates map fitting, zoom, panning, visible edges and directional keyboard navigation.

inputs.name: focusView.layout
inputs.description: The positioned map layout, including node IDs and whole-map dimensions. It supplies the nodes to bound and the whole-view fallback; unmatched IDs do not add bounds.

inputs.name: focusView.ids
inputs.description: The set of unit IDs to include in the focused view. IDs absent from the layout are ignored; no matches or all nodes matching returns the whole view.

inputs.name: focusOn.layout
inputs.description: The positioned map layout used to decide whether automatic focus applies. A focused view is calculated only when the layout has more than 60 nodes; otherwise the result is null.

inputs.name: focusOn.ids
inputs.description: The set of unit IDs to include if automatic focus applies. It is used only when the layout has more than 60 nodes.

inputs.name: zoomView.view
inputs.description: The current map viewport whose center and aspect ratio are preserved during zoom. Its width is used as the divisor when calculating the new height.

inputs.name: zoomView.factor
inputs.description: The zoom multiplier used to divide the current width. The new width is clamped to at least twice nodeSize.width and at most 1.5 times whole.width; the function does not validate the factor.

inputs.name: zoomView.whole
inputs.description: The whole-map viewport used to cap zoomed-out width at 1.5 times whole.width. Its x and height do not affect the calculation.

inputs.name: panView.view
inputs.description: The current map viewport to translate. Its dimensions are preserved.

inputs.name: panView.dx
inputs.description: The horizontal translation in map units. It is added directly to the viewport x coordinate.

inputs.name: panView.dy
inputs.description: The vertical translation in map units. It is added directly to the viewport y coordinate.

inputs.name: drawnEdges.layout
inputs.description: The map layout supplying the node count and dependency edges. At 60 nodes or fewer all edges are returned; above 60 only edges touching the selected ID are returned.

inputs.name: drawnEdges.selected
inputs.description: The selected unit ID, or null when there is no selection. It filters edges only when the layout has more than 60 nodes.

inputs.name: nextNode.layout
inputs.description: The positioned map nodes searched for the origin and directional candidates. Candidate nodes must also have IDs in shown; the origin only needs to exist in the layout.

inputs.name: nextNode.from
inputs.description: The ID of the node from which navigation starts. It must match a layout node; an unknown ID produces undefined.

inputs.name: nextNode.key
inputs.description: The direction key for navigation. Only ArrowLeft, ArrowRight, ArrowUp and ArrowDown are recognized; other strings produce undefined.

inputs.name: nextNode.shown
inputs.description: The set of unit IDs eligible as navigation destinations. If no eligible node lies ahead, the existing origin ID is returned even if it is not in this set.

inputs.name: wholeView.layout
inputs.description: The layout whose width and height define the whole-map viewport. The returned bounds start 24 units above and left of the layout and add 48 units to each dimension.

outputs.name: wholeView
outputs.description: The full layout viewport, expanded by the fixed 24-unit padding on every side.

outputs.name: focusView
outputs.description: The bounds of matched nodes, expanded to at least four cells in each dimension plus padding. It returns the whole view when no nodes or all nodes match, or when the calculated bounds are at least as large as the whole view in both dimensions.

outputs.name: focusOn
outputs.description: A focused viewport for layouts with more than 60 nodes, or null for smaller layouts. Its focus behavior follows focusView.

outputs.name: zoomView
outputs.description: A viewport scaled about its center while preserving aspect ratio. Its width is bounded by twice nodeSize.width and 1.5 times whole.width, with no separate height clamp.

outputs.name: panView
outputs.description: A viewport translated by dx and dy in map units. Width and height are unchanged and no map-boundary clamp is applied.

outputs.name: drawnEdges
outputs.description: All dependency edges for layouts with at most 60 nodes; above 60 nodes, only edges whose from or to ID equals selected are returned.

outputs.name: nextNode
outputs.description: The nearest shown node ahead in the requested direction, minimizing along-axis distance plus four times sideways distance. It returns the origin node ID if no candidate is ahead, and undefined for a missing origin or unrecognized key.
